reference.title: Pharmacokinetics of the CYP 3A substrate simvastatin following administration of delayed versus immediate release oral dosage forms.
reference.abstract: The interplay between gastrointestinal physiology (lower CYP 3A expression in the distal ileum and the colon) and formulation design (zero-order controlled release after a predetermined lag-time) resulted in successful absorption and bioavailability improvement and represent a viable strategy to reduce the dose of CYP 3A drugs.
